svg.title: Regular smithing stones by enemy scaling level
svg.desc: Columns are the enemy scaling level the game announces when a region opens ("tier 4 of 11, 1.95x"); rows are stone tier. | A tier-blind seed scatters every stone tier across every scaling level; a paced one reads as a diagonal.
svg.text: Regular smithing stones by enemy scaling level
Columns are the enemy scaling level the game announces when a region opens ("tier 4 of 11, 1.95x"); rows are stone tier.
A tier-blind seed scatters every stone tier across every scaling level; a paced one reads as a diagonal.
